summary: Fourteen capabilities in four groups: money (banking and payments, lending, securities analysis and pricing, investment and wealth management, financial risk and actuarial modeling, insurance, compliance and financial crime), law (legal research, legal practice and litigation support), public safety and justice (emergency dispatch, law enforcement and forensics, courts and corrections) and government services (social services, public revenue, registries and permits). BIAN service domains, ISO 20022 business areas and FIBO drove the finance breakdown; ACORD the insurance tasks; UTBMS and the EDRM model the legal tasks; NENA, NIMS, FBI CJIS services and NIEM domains the justice and emergency tasks; and UN COFOG the government split.

capabilities.name: Banking operations and payments
capabilities.definition: Given customer, account and payment instructions, maintain deposit accounts and their ledgers and move money between accounts and institutions.
onet_categories: Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: Seed kept. Card and payment fraud detection moved to govern.compliance_financial_crime so that all fraud and money-laundering screening sits together. Cash forecasting (CashFlow Guardian) left to enterprise.financial_planning, which models treasury cash forecasting.

tasks.name: Deposit account processing
tasks.definition: Given account agreements and posted transactions, maintain balances, accrue interest and fees, and produce statements for demand and savings accounts.
tasks.inputs: account agreements, product terms, transaction postings
tasks.outputs: account balances, accrued interest and fees, statements
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: interest and fee accrual can be checked against hand-computed cases, but there is no public test suite

tasks.name: Teller and branch transactions
tasks.definition: Given an in-person deposit, withdrawal, check cashing or cash order, validate it against the account and post it while balancing the teller drawer.
tasks.inputs: transaction slip or check image, account status, cash drawer state
tasks.outputs: posted transaction, receipt, drawer balance
tasks.benchmarkable: no: correctness is procedural and institution-specific

tasks.name: Payment clearing and settlement
tasks.definition: Given payment instructions (wire, automated clearing house, check image, instant payment), validate, route, net and settle them between institutions and report status.
tasks.inputs: payment initiation messages, routing directories, settlement accounts
tasks.outputs: cleared and settled payments, status reports, settlement positions
onet_products: IBM Check Processing Control System CPSC
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: ISO 20022 and NACHA file conformance can be tested against published message rules

tasks.name: Check issue matching (positive pay)
tasks.definition: Given an issuer's list of written checks and the checks presented for payment, flag presented items that do not match for a pay-or-return decision.
tasks.inputs: issued-check file, presented check images and MICR data
tasks.outputs: exception list, pay or return decisions
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: matching accuracy on synthetic issue and presentment files is measurable

capabilities.name: Credit scoring, lending and servicing
capabilities.definition: Given a borrower's application, credit history and financial statements, decide whether and on what terms to lend, then service and collect the loan.
onet_categories: Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: Seed 'Credit scoring, lending and loan servicing' kept; collections and consumer debt counseling added because O*NET lists many products for collectors and credit counselors. Portfolio-level credit risk moved to govern.risk_actuarial.

tasks.name: Credit scorecard development
tasks.definition: Given historical applications and repayment outcomes, fit and validate a model that ranks applicants by probability of default.
tasks.inputs: applicant attributes, bureau data, performance outcomes
tasks.outputs: scorecard or model, cut-offs, validation statistics
onet_products: Fair Isaac Application Risk Model Software
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: public credit datasets (for example Home Credit, German Credit) allow scored comparisons of discrimination and calibration

tasks.name: Credit bureau report retrieval
tasks.definition: Given a borrower's identity and permissible purpose, retrieve and merge credit bureau files into a single report with scores and attributes.
tasks.inputs: borrower identity, permissible purpose, bureau credentials
tasks.outputs: merged credit report, scores, derived attributes
tasks.benchmarkable: no: depends on proprietary bureau data access

tasks.name: Application decisioning and automated underwriting
tasks.definition: Given a loan application, bureau data and policy rules, return an approve, refer or decline decision with terms and conditions.
tasks.inputs: application data, credit report, collateral data, policy rules
tasks.outputs: decision, pricing and terms, conditions list
onet_products: White Clarke North America Credit Adjudication and Lending Management
Credit adjudication and lending management system CALMS
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: rule execution can be tested against published agency guidelines; decision quality needs outcome data

tasks.name: Commercial credit analysis and spreading
tasks.definition: Given a business borrower's financial statements and market data, spread the statements into a standard form and estimate default probability and a risk rating.
tasks.inputs: financial statements, industry and market data
tasks.outputs: spread statements, ratios, probability of default, risk grade
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: default prediction can be scored on public company bankruptcy datasets; statement spreading accuracy on filed statements

tasks.name: Loan origination
tasks.definition: Given a borrower's application and supporting documents, assemble the loan file, order verifications, track conditions and produce closing documents.
tasks.inputs: application (for example the Uniform Residential Loan Application), documents, verifications
tasks.outputs: complete loan file, disclosures, closing package
onet_products: Financial Industry Computer Systems Loan Originator
tasks.benchmarkable: no: workflow and disclosure correctness are jurisdiction-specific and procedural

tasks.name: Loan servicing and amortization
tasks.definition: Given booked loans and payments received, compute amortization schedules, apply payments, manage escrow and produce borrower statements.
tasks.inputs: loan terms, payment receipts, escrow items
tasks.outputs: amortization schedules, balances, escrow analyses, statements
onet_products: Financial Industry Computer Systems Loan Accountant
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: amortization, interest and escrow calculations have exact answers that can be checked

tasks.name: Collections and recovery
tasks.definition: Given delinquent accounts, prioritize them, schedule contact strategies, locate debtors and record promises and recoveries.
tasks.inputs: delinquent account data, contact history, skip-trace sources
tasks.outputs: prioritized work queues, contact strategy, recovery records
onet_products: Debt account management and collection software
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: roll-rate and cure prediction can be scored on historical delinquency data

tasks.name: Consumer debt management plans
tasks.definition: Given a consumer's debts, income and expenses, build a repayment or settlement plan and administer payments to creditors.
tasks.inputs: creditor list, balances and rates, household budget
tasks.outputs: debt management plan, disbursement schedule, progress reports
onet_products: Cooperative Processing Resources DMS Professional Suite
Paragon Financial Services Paragon Financial System
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: payoff schedules are exactly computable; plan quality is a judgment

capabilities.name: Securities analysis and pricing
capabilities.definition: Given market and company data, value securities and companies, price derivatives and fixed income instruments, and forecast prices.
capabilities.notes: Seed 'Investment analysis, portfolio management and trading' split in two: analysis and pricing of instruments here, portfolios, trading and client planning in govern.investment_management. Instrument pricing kept with analysis rather than risk because the pricing models are the same whether used for trading or for valuation.

tasks.name: Market data and financial information retrieval
tasks.definition: Given instruments, companies or indicators of interest, retrieve current and historical prices, fundamentals, filings and news.
tasks.inputs: instrument and entity identifiers, query
tasks.outputs: price histories, fundamentals, filings, news
tasks.benchmarkable: no: value is coverage and timeliness of licensed data

tasks.name: Company valuation and deal modeling
tasks.definition: Given a company's financials, comparable companies and transactions, estimate enterprise and equity value and the accretion or dilution of a proposed deal.
tasks.inputs: financial statements, projections, comparable company and transaction data
tasks.outputs: valuation range, discounted cash flow model, accretion or dilution analysis
onet_products: Quantifying marketability discount QMD modeling software
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: model mechanics are checkable, but valuation has no ground truth beyond later transaction prices

tasks.name: Technical analysis and charting
tasks.definition: Given price and volume histories, compute indicators and chart patterns and generate rule-based trading signals.
tasks.inputs: price and volume time series, indicator definitions
tasks.outputs: indicator series, charts, signals
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: indicator values are deterministic and can be checked against reference implementations

tasks.name: Market price and return forecasting
tasks.definition: Given price histories and explanatory variables, fit a model that forecasts returns, prices or volatility and evaluate it out of sample.
tasks.inputs: price series, economic and fundamental variables
tasks.outputs: forecasts with error statistics
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: out-of-sample forecast error on public price histories is measurable, as Numerai and the M6 competition do
tasks.notes: General machine-learning and forecasting methods belong to science; this task is the application to market prices.

tasks.name: Fund research and screening
tasks.definition: Given a universe of mutual funds, exchange-traded funds or annuities, screen and compare them on returns, risk, fees and holdings.
tasks.inputs: fund returns, holdings, fees, ratings
tasks.outputs: screens, comparison reports, risk-adjusted return measures
onet_products: Steele Mutual Fund and Variable Annuity Expert
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: risk-adjusted return measures are exactly computable from public return series

tasks.name: Option and derivative pricing
tasks.definition: Given an option, swap or exotic contract and market inputs, compute its fair value and sensitivities with an analytic, lattice or Monte Carlo model.
tasks.inputs: contract terms, underlying prices, volatility surface, rate curves
tasks.outputs: fair value, sensitivities (Greeks)
onet_products: Wolfram Research Mathematica UnRisk Pricing Engine
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: closed-form cases and published reference prices (for example in Hull's text and QuantLib's test suite) give exact targets

tasks.name: Fixed income and structured product analytics
tasks.definition: Given a bond, mortgage-backed security or convertible and market curves, compute price, yield, duration, convexity and projected cash flows.
tasks.inputs: security terms, yield curves, prepayment and default assumptions
tasks.outputs: price and yield, duration and convexity, cash-flow projections
onet_products: Tips Standard Securities Calculation Bond Analytics Module
Tips Standard Securities Calculation Mortgage-Backed Analytics Module
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: yield and accrued-interest conventions have exact answers (SIFMA standard formulas)

capabilities.name: Investment, trading and wealth management
capabilities.definition: Given investors' goals and holdings, construct and account for portfolios, execute trades, and plan individuals' long-term finances.
onet_categories: Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: Second half of seed 'Investment analysis, portfolio management and trading'. Personal financial planning added here because O*NET's Personal Financial Advisors list some 40 planning products and the function is portfolio and cash-flow projection for a household.

tasks.name: Portfolio construction and asset allocation
tasks.definition: Given expected returns, risks, correlations and constraints, choose portfolio weights that optimize a risk-return objective.
tasks.inputs: capital market assumptions, covariance estimates, constraints
tasks.outputs: target weights, efficient frontier, rebalancing trades
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: optimization problems with known optima and out-of-sample portfolio performance are both measurable

tasks.name: Performance measurement and attribution
tasks.definition: Given holdings, transactions and benchmark data, compute time-weighted returns and attribute them to allocation, selection and factor effects.
tasks.inputs: holdings, transactions, prices, benchmarks
tasks.outputs: returns by period, attribution reports, risk-adjusted measures
onet_products: I-flex Solutions Reveleus Investment Performance Measurement
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: GIPS return calculations and Brinson attribution have exact answers

tasks.name: Portfolio accounting and investment book of record
tasks.definition: Given trades, corporate actions and prices, maintain positions, cost basis, accruals and valuations for each portfolio.
tasks.inputs: trades, corporate actions, prices, cash movements
tasks.outputs: positions, cost basis, realized and unrealized gains, statements
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: positions and cost basis after a scripted series of trades and corporate actions are exactly checkable

tasks.name: Order management and electronic trade execution
tasks.definition: Given investment decisions, create, route and execute orders on trading venues and record fills and allocations.
tasks.inputs: orders, venue connectivity, market data
tasks.outputs: executions, fills, allocations
onet_products: Charles River Development Charles River Investment Management System
Fixed income alternative trading systems ATS
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: execution cost against arrival price can be measured in simulation; venue connectivity cannot

tasks.name: Trading strategy backtesting
tasks.definition: Given a trading rule and historical market data, simulate its trades with costs and report returns, drawdowns and risk.
tasks.inputs: strategy rules, historical prices, cost model
tasks.outputs: simulated trades, equity curve, performance statistics
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: deterministic replays on public price data give checkable results

tasks.name: Personal financial and retirement planning
tasks.definition: Given a household's assets, income, spending and goals, project its finances to and through retirement and test the plan's probability of success.
tasks.inputs: assets and liabilities, income and spending, goals, assumptions
tasks.outputs: cash-flow projection, probability of success, recommendations
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: projections are reproducible given assumptions, but there is no outcome ground truth

tasks.name: Estate, education and insurance needs analysis
tasks.definition: Given a household's situation and a goal or contingency, compute the amount needed to fund it and the effect of estate transfers and taxes.
tasks.inputs: family data, assets, goal or contingency, tax rules
tasks.outputs: funding need, estate tax and transfer projections
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: estate tax computations are exact under stated law; needs are judgments

tasks.name: Household money management
tasks.definition: Given a household's account transactions, categorize spending, track budgets and net worth over time.
tasks.inputs: account transactions, categories, budgets
tasks.outputs: categorized spending, budget variance, net worth
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: transaction categorization accuracy is measurable on labeled data
tasks.notes: Kept here as the household side of money management; business bookkeeping is enterprise.

capabilities.name: Financial risk and actuarial modeling
capabilities.definition: Given portfolios, balance sheets or insurance and pension liabilities, quantify the distribution of losses and the reserves and capital needed to cover them.

crosswalk.label: Interest rate risk in the banking book

capabilities.notes: Seed kept. General Monte Carlo spreadsheet add-ins (Palisade @Risk, Crystal Ball) are general simulation tools and are handed to science rather than listed here. Pension plan valuation added because it is actuarial work O*NET lists under benefits software.

tasks.name: Market risk measurement
tasks.definition: Given positions and market factor histories or scenarios, compute value at risk, expected shortfall and stress losses.
tasks.inputs: positions, pricing models, factor histories or scenarios
tasks.outputs: value at risk, expected shortfall, stress test results
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: value at risk on a fixed portfolio and scenario set is exactly computable; backtests against realized losses are standard

tasks.name: Credit portfolio risk
tasks.definition: Given exposures, default probabilities and correlations, estimate the portfolio loss distribution and economic or regulatory capital.
tasks.inputs: exposures, default probabilities, recovery rates, correlation model
tasks.outputs: expected and unexpected loss, capital, concentration reports
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: capital formulas under the Basel internal-ratings approach are exact; model choice is not

tasks.name: Asset-liability and interest rate risk
tasks.definition: Given a bank's balance sheet and rate scenarios, project net interest income and economic value of equity and measure repricing gaps.
tasks.inputs: balance sheet by repricing bucket, behavioral assumptions, rate scenarios
tasks.outputs: net interest income and economic value projections, gap reports

crosswalk.label: Interest rate risk in the banking book

tasks.benchmarkable: partly: standardized rate-shock calculations are exact; behavioral assumptions are not

tasks.name: Life, annuity and health liability projection
tasks.definition: Given policies in force, mortality, lapse and economic assumptions, project liability cash flows and compute reserves and embedded value.
tasks.inputs: policy data, assumption tables, economic scenarios
tasks.outputs: projected cash flows, reserves, embedded value
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: reserve calculations on published model points and tables (for example Society of Actuaries mortality tables) have exact answers

tasks.name: Property and casualty loss reserving
tasks.definition: Given paid and incurred claim triangles, estimate ultimate losses and unpaid claim reserves with their uncertainty.
tasks.inputs: loss development triangles, exposures
tasks.outputs: ultimate loss estimates, reserves, reserve ranges
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: Casualty Actuarial Society loss reserving data sets allow scoring of reserve estimates against later developed values

tasks.name: Pension and benefit plan valuation
tasks.definition: Given plan provisions, participant data and assumptions, compute plan liabilities, funding requirements and nondiscrimination test results.
tasks.inputs: plan provisions, census data, actuarial assumptions
tasks.outputs: liabilities, required contributions, test results
onet_products: Actuarial Systems Corporation Defined Benefit System
Actuarial Systems Corporation Compliance Testing System
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: funding and liability calculations under published rules have exact answers for given data

capabilities.name: Insurance underwriting and claims
capabilities.definition: Given risks to be insured and losses reported, rate and underwrite policies, administer them, and adjust, value and pay claims.
onet_categories: Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: Seed 'Insurance: underwriting, claims and estimating' kept. Reserving moved to govern.risk_actuarial. Agency management and insurance sales tools are commerce.

tasks.name: Insurance rating and quoting
tasks.definition: Given a risk's characteristics and a filed rating plan, compute the premium and produce a quote.
tasks.inputs: risk characteristics, rating tables and rules
tasks.outputs: premium, quote
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: premium for a given risk under a published filed rating plan is exact

tasks.name: Underwriting risk assessment
tasks.definition: Given an application and evidence (medical, motor, property, loss history), classify the risk and decide acceptance, class and exclusions.
tasks.inputs: application, evidence, underwriting guidelines
tasks.outputs: risk class, decision, exclusions and loadings
onet_products: Fair Isaac Enterprise Decision Management for Insurance
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: rule execution is checkable; risk selection quality needs claims outcomes

tasks.name: Policy administration and issuance
tasks.definition: Given bound coverage, issue the policy, produce documents, and process endorsements, renewals and cancellations.
tasks.inputs: bound coverage, forms library, policy changes
tasks.outputs: issued policy, documents, billing records
onet_products: Consilience Software Maven Insurance Automation Suite
Tritech Financial Systems General Insurance Management System GIMS
tasks.benchmarkable: no: procedural, product-specific

tasks.name: Claims intake and adjudication
tasks.definition: Given a first notice of loss and supporting evidence, verify coverage, set reserves, manage the investigation and decide payment.
tasks.inputs: loss notice, policy, evidence, adjuster notes
tasks.outputs: coverage decision, reserve, payment, claim file
onet_products: Claims processing administration and management software
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: coverage decisions on synthetic claims against policy wording can be scored

tasks.name: Bodily injury and liability evaluation
tasks.definition: Given injury, treatment and accident facts, estimate the value of a bodily injury claim and the apportionment of fault.
tasks.inputs: injury and treatment records, accident facts, jurisdiction
tasks.outputs: claim value range, fault apportionment
onet_products: Property damage, bodily injury, and liability estimation software
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: medical bill review against fee schedules is exact; injury valuation is judgment

tasks.name: Property and vehicle damage estimating
tasks.definition: Given photos, measurements or a damage inspection, itemize repair operations, parts and labor and price the repair.
tasks.inputs: damage photos or inspection, structure or vehicle data, regional price databases
tasks.outputs: itemized repair estimate, total loss decision
onet_products: Information Services Inc. CCC Pathways Appraisal Solution
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: image-based damage detection can be scored on labeled vehicle-damage datasets; full estimates need price data

tasks.name: Insurance claims fraud detection
tasks.definition: Given claims and related parties, score claims for fraud likelihood and surface linked networks for investigation.
tasks.inputs: claim data, party and provider networks, industry claim databases
tasks.outputs: fraud scores, referral lists, link charts
onet_products: Axonwave Fraud and Abuse Management System
IBM Fraud and Abuse Management System
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: detection accuracy can be scored on public synthetic and anonymized claim datasets

capabilities.name: Regulatory compliance and financial crime
capabilities.definition: Given regulations, an organization's activities and its transactions, keep controls mapped to obligations, file required reports, and detect fraud and money laundering.
capabilities.notes: Seed 'Regulatory compliance and filings' broadened to include fraud and anti-money-laundering detection; no seed covered it, and O*NET lists card-fraud, transaction-analysis and brokerage-surveillance products. Quality management systems (MasterControl, EtQ, QUMAS) and environmental compliance are handed off; insurance claims fraud stays with govern.insurance. The controls task here is mapping external regulatory obligations to controls; internal audit and enterprise risk registers are enterprise.audit_risk.

tasks.name: Compliance obligations and controls management
tasks.definition: Given applicable obligations and the organization's processes, map controls to obligations, schedule tests, and track issues and remediation.
tasks.inputs: obligation library, process and control inventory, test results
tasks.outputs: control matrix, test schedule, issue log, attestation reports
onet_products: Governance, risk, and compliance GRC software
Oracle Enterprise Governance, Risk, and Compliance Manager
tasks.benchmarkable: no: procedural workflow with no reference answer

tasks.name: Regulatory change monitoring
tasks.definition: Given jurisdictions and business lines, track new and amended rules and map each change to affected obligations and controls.
tasks.inputs: regulatory publications, obligation library
tasks.outputs: change alerts, impact assessments, updated obligations
onet_products: ODEN Insurance Services State Rules & Regulations
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: mapping rule text to obligations can be scored on labeled corpora

tasks.name: Regulatory reporting and filing
tasks.definition: Given an institution's books and a regulator's taxonomy and rules, compute required returns, validate them and file them in the prescribed format.
tasks.inputs: general ledger and risk data, report templates and validation rules
tasks.outputs: validated regulatory returns, filed submissions
onet_products: System for Electronic Rate and Form Filing SERFF
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: XBRL conformance suites and regulator validation rules give exact pass or fail

tasks.name: Regulated product submissions
tasks.definition: Given a product's dossier of studies and documents, assemble, validate and publish a submission in the regulator's structure (for example electronic Common Technical Document).
tasks.inputs: documents, metadata, regulator specification
tasks.outputs: validated submission package, submission tracking
onet_products: Thomson Reuters Liquent CoreDossier Submission Accelerator for eCTD
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: regulator technical validation criteria for eCTD give exact pass or fail
tasks.notes: Function is regulatory submission; the products are mostly pharmaceutical, so see_also health.

tasks.name: Supervisory examination
tasks.definition: Given a supervised institution's records and an examination program, analyze transactions and records and document findings and ratings.
tasks.inputs: institution data extracts, examination procedures
tasks.outputs: workpapers, findings, supervisory ratings
tasks.benchmarkable: no: findings are judgments without reference answers

tasks.name: Trading and conduct surveillance
tasks.definition: Given orders, trades and communications, detect market abuse, rule breaches and personal trading conflicts and manage the resulting alerts.
tasks.inputs: order and trade records, employee holdings, communications
tasks.outputs: alerts, case files, attestations
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: detection on synthetic order books with injected manipulation patterns is scorable

tasks.name: Anti-money-laundering monitoring and sanctions screening
tasks.definition: Given customers, counterparties and transactions, screen names against sanctions and watch lists and flag transaction patterns indicative of laundering.
tasks.inputs: customer and counterparty data, transactions, sanctions and watch lists
tasks.outputs: screening hits, alerts, suspicious activity reports
state_of_art: Oracle Financial Crime and Compliance Management
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: name-matching accuracy on labeled watch-list pairs and detection on synthetic transaction sets (for example IBM's AML synthetic data) are measurable
tasks.notes: No O*NET product names this function directly; included because it is a core regulated function of banks.

tasks.name: Card and payment fraud detection
tasks.definition: Given authorization and payment events with account history, score each event for fraud in real time and decide to approve, decline or challenge.
tasks.inputs: transaction stream, account and device history
tasks.outputs: fraud scores, decisions, case queue
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: public labeled datasets (for example the IEEE-CIS fraud data) support scored comparison

capabilities.name: Legal research and analytics
capabilities.definition: Given a legal question, find, verify and analyze the authorities, court records and public records that bear on it.
onet_categories: Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: Seed kept. Public records and person search added: paralegals, collectors and investigators use the same products for locating parties.

tasks.name: Case law and statute search
tasks.definition: Given a legal question or citation, retrieve the relevant cases, statutes and regulations ranked by relevance.
tasks.inputs: natural-language question, citation or Boolean query, jurisdiction
tasks.outputs: ranked authorities with excerpts
onet_products: FindLaw Code of Federal Regulations CFR
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: legal retrieval benchmarks (COLIEE, LegalBench retrieval tasks) give scored comparisons

tasks.name: Citation validation
tasks.definition: Given an authority or a brief, determine whether each cited authority is still good law and how later decisions treated it.
tasks.inputs: case citation or document with citations
tasks.outputs: treatment flags, citing references
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: citation extraction is scorable on labeled briefs; negative-treatment labels are proprietary

tasks.name: Court docket and filing retrieval
tasks.definition: Given a party, case number or court, retrieve docket entries and filed documents.
tasks.inputs: party name, case number, court
tasks.outputs: docket sheets, filed documents
onet_products: Public Access to Court Electronic Records (PACER)
Public access to electronic court records PACER
tasks.benchmarkable: no: an access problem rather than a computation

tasks.name: Litigation analytics
tasks.definition: Given courts, judges, parties or counsel, summarize historical case outcomes, timings and motion results.
tasks.inputs: docket and outcome data, entity of interest
tasks.outputs: outcome rates, time-to-ruling statistics, profiles
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: outcome prediction can be scored on public docket data such as CourtListener's

tasks.name: Trademark clearance search
tasks.definition: Given a proposed mark and classes, find registered and common-law marks likely to conflict.
tasks.inputs: proposed mark, goods and services classes
tasks.outputs: ranked conflicting marks, clearance report
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: retrieval of known conflicting marks from public registers can be scored

tasks.name: Court and legal forms retrieval
tasks.definition: Given a jurisdiction and filing type, retrieve the current official form and its filing rules.
tasks.inputs: jurisdiction, filing type
tasks.outputs: current official forms, filing instructions
tasks.benchmarkable: no: currency of a forms library, not a computation

tasks.name: Public records and party search
tasks.definition: Given identifying details about a person or business, retrieve and link public records such as addresses, assets, filings and relatives.
tasks.inputs: name and identifiers
tasks.outputs: linked person or business report
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: record linkage accuracy is measurable on labeled public datasets

capabilities.name: Legal matter management and litigation support
capabilities.definition: Given a firm's or legal department's matters, manage their records, deadlines, documents, time and bills, and process and present evidence in litigation.
onet_categories: Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: Seed 'Legal practice, case and matter management; e-discovery; docketing' kept as one capability with e-discovery split into two tasks along the EDRM stages. Legal time and billing kept here (not enterprise) because LEDES and UTBMS make it a legal-specific function.

tasks.name: Matter and case management
tasks.definition: Given a legal matter, keep its parties, contacts, events, documents, notes and conflicts in one record and check new matters for conflicts of interest.
tasks.inputs: matter intake, parties, documents, events
tasks.outputs: matter record, conflict check results, task lists
tasks.benchmarkable: no: procedural records management

tasks.name: Court-rule docketing and deadline calculation
tasks.definition: Given a triggering event in a case and the governing court rules, compute every resulting deadline and calendar it.
tasks.inputs: trigger event and date, court and case type, rule sets, court holidays
tasks.outputs: calculated deadlines with rule citations
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: deadlines under published court rules have exact answers for a given trigger

tasks.name: Contract review and clause analysis
tasks.definition: Given contracts, extract key terms and obligations, flag deviations from standard positions and track renewals and obligations.
tasks.inputs: contract documents, playbook positions

tasks.definition: Given custodians' data sources, collect, de-duplicate, extract text and metadata, and index documents for review.

Federal Emergency Management Information System FEMIS

open_questions: Customs: duty assessment and tariff classification are placed in govern.public_administration; move may also claim them. Decide one owner.

Fraud: payment and anti-money-laundering detection are in govern.compliance_financial_crime, claims fraud in govern.insurance, and forensic accounting handed to enterprise audit. Should all fraud detection be one capability?
Digital evidence examination is in govern.law_enforcement with a see_also to computing security; computing may model the same tools under incident response.
Pension plan valuation sits in govern.risk_actuarial while benefits administration is enterprise HR; confirm the split.
Household money management (Quicken) is placed under govern.investment_management; enterprise could claim it as accounting.
Regulated product submissions (eCTD) are in govern.compliance_financial_crime; health may want them alongside clinical trials.
Animal control and shelter software has no obvious owner; it is listed as unplaced.
Fifteen capabilities would have kept public revenue apart from registries and permits; they are merged here to stay within fourteen.
